entities.source_role: B-18 set pieces and fittings: OpenLetter, SteelTable
entities.structural_constraints: each member keeps its own source footprint, size and placement

motion_contract.action: holds its source position for the whole shot
motion_contract.continuity_requirement: keep every instance and the column order exactly as in the source
motion_contract.forbidden_substitutions: do not merge, split, drop or reorder the instances

interaction_contracts.relation: the letter lies spread open on the steel table with the clauses in columns
interaction_contracts.forbidden_change: do not add a signature and do not add a second sheet

camera_contract.world_path: camera travels from (-2.00, 9.40, 1.72) to (-2.00, 9.40, 1.72) on a 50mm lens, total path length 0.00m inside the blocked set
camera_contract.screen_composition_rule: 特写 framing in 9:16 vertical, subject held in the frame centre band with head room above, foreground occlusion kept under one third of frame, and the AI badge corner left clear of the subject
camera_contract.forbidden_reinterpretations: do not add any camera move, zoom or handheld shake; keep the 特写 framing and the 固定 move exactly as blocked out

shots.actions: one letter lies spread open on the steel table and the layout is the layout of a contract with the clauses set in columns; the paper carries no signature; the clause columns are written straight in Chinese and read character by character
shots.layout_and_occlusion: 2 visible instances. Dominant SteelTable covers 100x65 percent at frame 50/68. Left to right: OpenLetter, SteelTable.
shots.lighting_spatial_logic: one cold overhead key over the steel table with shadow detail retained instead of crushed black, cold grey bounce from concrete and steel, the emergency lamps on the gate posts, the residual fire heads, the twin flame and the derrick lamp as the only moving light sources, and the grey fog pressing down over the street with the unlit crossing kept dark
